notes_for_editor: The Forest Lookouts page for New Castle Hill ends with a bare word 'Removed' that I could not interpret, so it is not used. The 1934-35 newspaper extracts name the Ohio State Forestry Department as operator, while the FFLOS record names the U.S. Forest Service as administrator; both are kept (the Wayne National Forest's first land acquisitions date to 1935, the year after the tower was reported). The 40 feet in the 1935 article is the height of the cab above the ground, not a tower height, so no height_m is recorded. The Vindy 2006 article is statewide context and is not site-specific. A Forest Fire Lookout Association post about the Hanging Rock Fire Tower concerns a West Virginia tower and was not used. No photos found. Fact-check 2026-10-09: the story no longer infers that the tower was finished in autumn 1934 (the Gazette gives no construction date), so the 1934 entry is 'other' rather than 'built'.
